tensors.role: Block 0 Query matrix: projects tokens into what they are looking for.

tensors.role: Block 0 Key matrix: projects tokens into what they advertise to others.

tensors.role: Block 0 Value matrix: projects the information a token passes along.

tensors.name: blocks.0.attn.W_o.weight
tensors.role: Block 0 Output projection: blends all 4 attention heads back into the residual stream.
